test_cases.path_step: The Teacher navigates to a pre-existing course by clicking on its entry in the course list on the Dashboard.
test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 4: BULK STUDENT MANAGEMENT AND REMOVAL - Phase 1: Preparation
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Navigates to Pre-existing Course from Dashboard
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with a pre-provisioned account is successfully logged into the system and is on the Dashboard Page. At least one course, named 'Temporary Course for Deletion', exists and is visible on the Dashboard.
test_cases.expected_result: The system navigates to the 'Course Details Page' for the selected course, displaying its information and available tabs (Info, Sessions, Forum, Files, Students). The course information, schedule, and uploaded materials are visible.
test_cases.post_condition: The Teacher is on the 'Course Details Page' for the selected course, ready to manage its content or students.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Course List' entry for 'Temporary Course for Deletion'.
